title: cast_column: convert a column type
description: Convert a single column to string, int, float, boolean, or datetime. Use this when the user asks to change a column type or parse dates/numbers.

parameters.name: target_type
parameters.description: One of string, int, float, boolean, datetime.

parameters.name: errors
parameters.description: raise or coerce. Default is raise.

rag_note: Use errors='coerce' only if the user accepts invalid values becoming missing/null.
